description: This file contains unit tests for the ConnectivityCounterRegistry class in the Eclipse Ditto project. It sets up various counters, performs aggregations, and tests the merging and immutability of metrics related to connectivity messaging counters.

classes.name: ConnectivityCounterRegistryTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the functionality and correctness of the ConnectivityCounterRegistry, including aggregation of metrics, merging responses, and ensuring immutability.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Static setup method annotated with @BeforeClass that initializes counters with sample data for subsequent tests.

methods.name: testAggregateSourceMetrics
methods.description: Test method that verifies the aggregation of source metrics from the registry.

methods.name: testAggregateTargetMetrics
methods.description: Test method that verifies the aggregation of target metrics from the registry.

methods.name: getMeasurement
methods.description: Helper method to create a Measurement object with specified MetricType and boolean, using predefined counters.

methods.name: mergeRetrieveConnectionMetricsResponses
methods.description: Test method that validates the merging of two RetrieveConnectionMetricsResponse objects, checking various metric summaries and source/target key correctness.

methods.name: testImmutability
methods.description: Test method to ensure that instances of ConnectivityCounterRegistry are immutable according to the MutabilityDetector assertions.
